back: Getting things done through other people by planning, organising, commanding, coordinating and controlling resources.
Planning, organising, commanding (directing / leading), coordinating, controlling.
Making sure the different people and departments work together towards the same objectives.
Measuring actual performance, comparing it with the plan and correcting problems.
Giving a subordinate the authority to carry out a task; the manager keeps responsibility.

front: Authority or responsibility: which can be delegated?
back: Authority can be delegated. Responsibility for the result stays with the manager.
Frees the manager's time, faster decisions, motivates and develops subordinates, uses specialists' skills.
Task may be done badly, manager still responsible, time to train and check, manager may feel a loss of control.
